issues.display_title: Issue #501: Add Bookmark Status to Search Post
issues.main_description_html:
RESULT 13/08/26

✅ Implementation: Add Bookmark Status to Search Post

Changes

  • Added bookmark and folder fields to Models.SearchPost.
  • Loaded the authenticated user's bookmark map once with Redis.ListBookmarksUser.
  • Matched each search result against the bookmark map by post slug.
  • Returned the bookmarked folder slug through folder.
  • Added bookmark and folder to supported include fields.
  • Added a focused test for bookmarked and unbookmarked result mapping.

Modified Areas

  • src/Action/V1/Search/SearchPost.go
  • src/Action/V1/Search/SearchPost_test.go
  • src/Models/PostsModel.go

Verification

go test ./src/Action/V1/Search ./src/Models -count=1
git diff --check

Results:

  • Search and model package tests passed.
  • Diff whitespace validation passed.

Scope

  • Add bookmark status to GET /search/post results.
  • Follow Post Detail response semantics.
  • Return bookmark folder slug when the post is bookmarked.
  • Support bookmark fields through the include query parameter.

Response Fields

  • bookmark: true when the authenticated user bookmarked the post; otherwise false.
  • folder: bookmark folder slug when bookmarked; otherwise null.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Search results include bookmark and folder by default.
  • include=bookmark,folder returns both fields.
  • Bookmark data is loaded once and matched to each result by post slug.
  • Viewer results return bookmark: false and folder: null.
  • Automated tests cover bookmarked and unbookmarked posts.
